name: ATM Key Download Request V 05
definition: The ATMKeyDownloadRequest message is sent by an ATM to an ATM manager to initiate the download of one or several cryptographic keys.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMKeyDownloadRequest.name: ATM Key Download Request
ATMKeyDownloadRequest.definition: Information related to the request of a key download from an ATM.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
